verdict.rationale: Working Copy does have an automation surface, its x-callback-url scheme, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, its own documentation says the scheme is written as prose with "no machine-readable schema", and probes of every common OpenAPI path returned 404. The axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
